expectations.text: The routing decision remains structured and complete.
expectations.evidence: The router returns a routing decision with dispatchable status, tier, exact selected model and effort, reason, escalation trigger, and an exact same-tier fallback or none. The caller controls how that result is stored and presented. That separation does not permit implicit model or effort values: a dispatchable result requires exact values accepted by the interface; model names alone, default, auto, inherited, or unresolved values are insufficient.
